svg.title: Stem cell
svg.desc: Single slender crypt-base columnar stem cell with a narrow apical surface, gently tapered body, basal oval nucleus, and sparse cytoplasmic organelles. Biological basis: LGR5-positive crypt-base columnar stem cells alternate with Paneth cells and continuously generate the intestinal epithelial lineages.
